description: Utility functions for a food delivery application, including distance calculation, order time estimation, review sorting, restaurant open status, and grouping data.

methods.name: calculateDistance
methods.description: Calculates the geographical distance between two latitude/longitude points using the Haversine formula.

methods.name: calulateRemainingTime
methods.description: Estimates remaining time for an order based on its status and timestamps.

methods.name: calculateDaysAgo
methods.description: Calculates the number of days between the current date and a target date.

methods.name: groupAndCount
methods.description: Groups array items by a specified key and counts occurrences, with special handling for zero values.

methods.name: sortReviews
methods.description: Sorts reviews based on specified criteria: newest, highest rating, or lowest rating.

methods.name: calculateAmount
methods.description: Calculates delivery cost based on cost type and distance.

methods.name: isOpen
methods.description: Determines if a restaurant is currently open based on its opening times and availability.

methods.name: sortRestaurantsByOpenStatus
methods.description: Sorts a list of restaurants, prioritizing open ones.
